text: Get the settings page working with an OpenRouter key.

The Settings window is in, with the key field, the daily budget and private folders. The runner keeps the key in `secrets/openrouter-key` and the app only ever hears whether one is set.

I tested it with a fake key. To see a real title come back I need a real one.

asks.action: Paste your OpenRouter key into Settings and turn on titles

asks.why:
My picks are in brackets:
- Is a $1 daily budget right? (yes)
- Should titles stop for the day when it runs out? (yes)
